about: The simulated Copilot Service admin center's pages. Menu path, page, section, button and field names as the real admin center shows them (checked in a Microsoft demo environment on 2026-11-02), with the Learn article for each page. Our own look. Only the Contact Center parts; the Customer Service parts (basic queues, routing dialogs, case and email settings) are left out. Descriptions are our own words or quoted from Learn.
notice: Omnichannel configuration changes take up to 15 minutes to reflect.
noticeTraining: In the training, changes take effect straight away.

queues.title: Queues
queues.intro: Queues collect work and hand it out to customer service representatives.

cards.title: Advanced queues
cards.description: Set assignment methods to distribute work automatically, and manage the queue's users, operating hours and overflow.

createDialog.title: Create a queue
createDialog.intro: A queue collects work for a group of users. After you create it, you add users, an assignment method and operation hours.

fields.name: Name
fields.priorityInfo: A smaller number is a higher priority: queue 1 is served before queue 2.

users.empty: No users yet. Select Add users.

addUsersPanel.title: Add Users
addUsersPanel.intro: Pick the customer service representatives who can get work from this queue.

overflow.title: Overflow handling
overflow.source: Labels from Learn, Manage overflow of work items in queues (ms.date 2026-10-30), not yet checked in the admin center. Transfer to an external number isn't in the training. The training takes wait time in queue in seconds; the admin center takes a number and a unit.

operationHours.title: Operation hours
operationHours.text: Without operation hours, the queue is open 24/7.

operationHoursDialog.title: Set operation hours
operationHoursDialog.name: Name
operationHoursDialog.source: Learn, Create and manage queues for unified routing (ms.date 2026-07-22)

assignment-method.title: Assignment method
assignment-method.intro: Pick how this queue hands out its work. A custom assignment method (Create new) isn't part of the training yet.

methods.name: Highest capacity
methods.description: Assigns a work item to a service representative with the highest available capacity. (Learn)

methods.name: Advanced round robin
methods.description: Assigns a work item to the representative who matches the criteria for skills, presence, and capacity. The initial order is based on when a user is added to the queue. (Learn)

methods.name: Least active
methods.description: Assigns a work item to the representative who has been least active among all those who match skills, presence, and capacity. (Learn)

methods.name: No auto assignment
methods.description: Work items stay in the queue until someone assigns them by hand.

createDialog.title: Create a workstream
createDialog.name: Name
createDialog.pushNote: For voice, push mode only is available.
createDialog.source: Learn, Create and manage workstreams (ms.date 2026-05-08). The training creates voice workstreams only.

routingRules.title: Routing rules
routingRules.noFallback: No fallback queue is set for this workstream: work that matches no rule goes to the default queue.
routingRules.classificationText: Add details to incoming work with classification rules, for more precise routing and assignment.
routingRules.routeToQueuesText: Rules send incoming work to the right queue. Work that matches no rule goes to the fallback queue.

decision-list.title: Decision list
decision-list.info: Before sending a work item to a queue, we'll match rules and overflow actions in priority order. If we don't find any queue that have not overflowed, work items will be sent to the earliest operating queue or follow the rule's overflow action.

panel.title: Create route to queue rule
panel.intro: Add conditions and select the queue to route to.
panel.rootRecordText: Conditions start from the conversation, and can use its related records and attributes.
panel.simplified: Simplified for the training: fields are the workstream's context variables (in the admin center they're under the related entity Context item value) and Priority Score. Operators the training leaves out: Does not contain, Begins with, Does not begin with, Ends with, Does not end with, In, Not In and Does not contain data.
panel.relatedEntityOff: Related entities other than Context item value aren't in the training.

channels.title: Channels
channels.source: Learn, Manage phone numbers (ms.date 2026-06-17): Channels in Customer support, then Manage for Phone numbers. Only the Phone numbers card is in the training.

cards.title: Phone numbers
cards.description: Get phone numbers for the voice channel and put them on voice workstreams.

phone-numbers.title: Phone numbers
phone-numbers.source: Button, dialog, field and status names from Learn, Manage phone numbers (ms.date 2026-06-17), not yet checked in the admin center. The column names are our words for what Learn says the list shows.

dialog.title: Add phone number
dialog.fiction: Simulated: the training hands out numbers reserved for fiction (US 555-0100 to 555-0199, London 020 7946 0000 to 0999). There are no fictional toll-free numbers, so Toll-free and SMS are off.
dialog.usOnly: In the real admin center, only United States numbers are bought here; numbers from other countries come from Azure Communication Services.

setupDialog.title: Setup workstream
setupDialog.intro: A phone number can be on only one voice workstream. The training adds a voice channel with this number to the workstream you pick.

user-management.title: User management

cards.title: Capacity profile
cards.description: Set how much work representatives can take at the same time.

cards.title: Skills hub
cards.description: Create skills and give them to representatives, with how well they know each one.

user-management.source: Learn, Create and manage capacity profiles (ms.date 2026-02-03) and Set up skills and assign representatives (ms.date 2026-05-08): User management in Customer support, then Manage for Capacity profile or Skills hub.

capacity-profiles.title: Capacity profiles

profile.noUsers: No users have this profile yet.

capacity-profiles.source: Labels from Learn, Create and manage capacity profiles (ms.date 2026-02-03), not yet checked in the admin center. Reset frequency and Assignment blocking aren't simulated.

teams.title: Teams
teams.defaultTeam: This is the business unit's default team: its members are the business unit's users, and can't be changed here.

skills.title: Skills

createDialog.title: Create Skill
createDialog.typeHint: Skill types are an option set in the classic settings; the training has one.
createDialog.name: Skill name

edit.title: Edit Skill
edit.added: New users get the lowest proficiency. Tick them and select Update proficiency to change it.

skills.source: Learn, Set up skills and assign representatives (ms.date 2026-05-08): Skills hub, Manage in the Skills area, Create, Skill type, Skill name, Add, Add selected users, Update proficiency. Simplified: changes are saved straight away.

classification.title: Work classification
classification.simplified: Simplified: each skill attachment rule checks one field with Equals and attaches one skill. The first rule that matches attaches its skill.
classification.source: Learn, Configure work classification rulesets (ms.date 2026-05-08): Routing rules, Work classification (optional), Create Ruleset, then Create Rule with a name, Conditions and Output.
classification.noRulesets: No work classification rulesets yet. Select Create new.
classification.skillRulesText: The training's own simplified rules that attach a skill to a call. In the admin center, Skills is one of the attributes a work classification rule's Output can set.

createDialog.title: Create work classification ruleset
createDialog.logicalText: Create conditions to define your rules based on multiple entity attributes.
createDialog.template: Start new or use a template
createDialog.name: Name

ruleset.info: Rules are checked in order. The first rule that matches sets its output, and then the next ruleset runs.

rulePanel.title: Create work classification rule
rulePanel.intro: Add conditions and output attributes to define this rule.
rulePanel.rootRecordText: Root record is the starting record for the conditions and the output below. Starting from the root record you can navigate to its related records and attributes.
rulePanel.duplicates: We found some duplicate attributes. Change or remove any attributes that appear more than once.
rulePanel.simplified: Simplified for the training: Output can set Priority Score and context variables. The admin center also offers Capacity profile, Skills, Customer, Escalation Count, Issue, Language, Region and related records.

cards.title: Outbound and inbound profiles
cards.description: Set up how representatives call customers: the number they call from, the caller ID and the queue.

outbound-profiles.title: Outbound and inbound profiles

create.title: Create new profile
create.name: Profile name
create.noNumbers: No number here can make calls. Add a number with Make calls in Channels › Phone numbers first.

outbound-profiles.simplified: Simplified: one panel instead of the wizard's pages; Outbound behaviors (music, transfers, transcription and recording) keep their defaults, and inbound profiles aren't in the training.
outbound-profiles.source: Learn, Configure outbound and inbound profiles (ms.date 2026-07-30).

ppac.name: Power Platform admin center
ppac.source: Labels from Learn, Create or edit business units (ms.date 2025-05-21) and Teams in Dataverse (ms.date 2025-07-15), not yet checked in the admin center. Learn doesn't name the button that creates a team; the training uses Save.
